sources.title: Green Lantern: 10 Essential John Stewart Comics
snippets:
##  5  John Stewart Sees His Wife Again

DC's Blackest Night event pitted the Green Lantern Corps against Nekron – the force of death who reanimated dead heroes to eliminate all living things from the universe. In Green Lantern Vol 4 #49, John goes up against an army of Black Lanterns, including his late wife, Katma Tui. As emotions confront John, Katma, charged by Nekron, tells John the Black Lantern Corps is greater than him because it could do what he couldn't: save the victims of Xanshi.

John then uses his power to create a group of Marines, who fight alongside him against the Black Lanterns. This encounter with Katma made John think about his advice and how being a Green Lantern doesn't build character; it reveals it.
